objective: Preserve and measurably use goal-relevant identity, time, and order information.

clauses.text: Goal-relevant identity, time, and event order survive the complete processing path.
Evaluation distinguishes carrying information from actually using it.

non_goals: Do not build a production model.
constraints: Keep the fixture deterministic and offline.

acceptance_dimensions.description: Every goal-relevant information family has an explained end-to-end path.
A discriminating control tests whether outputs use the information.
evidence_requirements: Local control result and independent audit

escalation_conditions: Required information remains unexplained after a bounded iteration.
